notes.title: Prelude to The Endarkenment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926523/1d0bdb7687a1b18b52fb325ddd3e982a674202cc.jpg[/img]
I am currently developing a demo for The Endarkenment. It will serve as a prelude to the story and it'll introduce you to the main characters as well as give more context to the bigger mysteries of The Endarkenment. This demo will be free to play upon release and I will have further details as I get closer to completion. The release window I am aiming for will be later this summer or fall.

Explore the town of Cryptica, hike the mountain trails, or go socialize at a house party. Strange happenings will follow you no matter where you go.
